title: What Model Levels Do I Need?
author: TRIPMINE_Guy
selftext:
I'm using claude and am wondering what level I need to be using. I typically use Sonnet 5.5 high but I have to wonder if it is needed to be that high. Mybudget allocation is not sustainable at this rate. What are your opnions. I also have a grok and I found that it was able to find bugs unrelated to what it was fixing and fixed it but claude never tells me if it does that. (that might be a reflection on groks poor coding creating bugs). I feel like I am getting caught upo in words, like medium claude can't be better than high grok right? So i simply must use high?

My game is an rts/ fps hybrid so I am being very performance focused, and I am constantly telling my ai to consider the way we have coded the ai pathfinding and rendering and how changes might affect those things. I do not know if i am overdoing it though.
